# Thunderbird Try failure-causality analysis with conservative unknowns

For Calendar loader/draft revision `43b8792a07c4dc934ad5f92c9d04a11c39dcdfe3`, the full outgoing diff touched Calendar JavaScript/Redux state, packaging, and Calendar tests only. The later complete assessment classified all 20 failures unrelated; `596334513` reached `*** End BrowserChrome Test Results ***` and manifest completion before profile symbolication timed out. The earlier audit correctly requires `unknown` until that completion evidence is checked. [Task 2]

Scope: general.
